entries.title: Psalms 124:1
segments: ¶<A Song of the going up. Of David.> If it had not been the Lord who was on our side (let Israel now say);

entries.title: Psalms 124:2
segments: If it had not been the Lord who was on our side, when men came up against us;

entries.title: Psalms 124:3
segments: They would have made a meal of us while still living, in the heat of their wrath against us:

entries.title: Psalms 124:4
segments: We would have been covered by the waters; the streams would have gone over our soul;

entries.title: Psalms 124:5
segments: Yes, the waters of pride would have gone over our soul.

entries.title: Psalms 124:6
segments: ¶Praise be to the Lord, who has not let us be wounded by their teeth.

entries.title: Psalms 124:7
segments: Our soul has gone free like a bird out of the net of those who would take her: the net is broken, and we are free.

entries.title: Psalms 124:8
segments: Our help is in the name of the Lord, the maker of heaven and earth.
